videos.headline: UCLA takes down USC to win Big Ten championship
videos.description: Lauren Betts scores 17 points as UCLA defeats JuJu Watkins and USC to win the Big Ten title.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (UCLA takes down USC to win Big Ten championship) 2025/03/09 ESHEET

videos.headline: Malia Samuels steals it on one end, dishes nice assist on the other
videos.description: USC's Malia Samuels comes up with a clutch steal and passes a dime to Kiki Iriafen for the bucket vs. No. 4 UCLA.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Malia Samuels steals it on one end, dishes nice assist on the other) 2025/03/09 ESHEET

videos.headline: Avery Howell sinks a corner 3 for USC
videos.description: Kennedy Smith dishes to Avery Howell in the corner, who knocks down a 3-pointer for the Trojans.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Avery Howell sinks a corner 3 for USC) 2025/03/09 ESHEET

videos.headline: UCLA's Lauren Betts banks it in to beat shot clock
videos.description: UCLA's Lauren Betts gets to the rack and drops a layup off the glass vs. USC.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (UCLA's Lauren Betts banks it in to beat shot clock) 2025/03/09 ESHEET

videos.headline: Lauren Betts reaches 1K career points with clutch score for UCLA
videos.description: Lauren Betts gets the layup for 1,000 career points at UCLA in the fourth quarter vs. USC.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Lauren Betts reaches 1K career points with clutch score for UCLA) 2025/03/09 ESHEET
